### Israel Becomes Sodom
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/israel-becomes-sodom
Passage: Judges 19:30
Points:
- The absence of a godly king plunged Israel into severe moral and theological anarchy.
- The Levite's callous treatment and sacrifice of his concubine exposed deep corruption within Israel's spiritual leadership.
- Gibeah's depravity directly mirrored ancient Sodom, demonstrating that the Israelites had become as wicked as the Canaanites.
- When believers fail to live holy and separate lives, they inevitably adopt worldly patterns of sin.

### Read the Bible: Judges 19, Acts 23, Jeremiah 33, Psalms 3–4
Author: D.A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/judges-19-acts-23-jeremiah-33-psalms-3-4/
Passage: Judges 19:1
Points:
- The narrative illustrates the law of the jungle completely overtaking Israel in the absence of a king.
- Gibeah's inhabitants violated fundamental laws of hospitality through attempted violent assault.
- Both the homeowner and the Levite displayed profound cowardice by abandoning defenseless women to a violent mob.
- The Levite's horrific call for national outrage masked his own guilt and complicity in the tragedy.
